effectSummary.ko: 가시 덫에 속박된 적을 서리 올가미가 실제 맞히면 그 적에게 3초간 총 D90% 독 추가 피해를 줍니다. 속박·냉기 적중만으로 반복 발동하지 않으며 대상별 4초 간격입니다.
effectSummary.en: If Frost Snare actually hits an enemy rooted by Briar Trap, apply D90% secondary poison damage over 3s. Root or cold alone cannot retrigger it; 4s per target.

description.ko: 6m 안에 덫을 설치합니다. 0.4초 후 무장하고 최대 6초 기다립니다. 적 진입 시 반경 2.5m의 최대 5명에게 D80% 물리 피해와 1.2초 속박을 주며 사라집니다. 최대 1개입니다.
description.en: Place a trap within 6m. It arms after 0.4s and waits up to 6s. On enemy entry, hit up to 5 enemies in 2.5m for D80% physical damage and a 1.2s root, then remove it. Limit 1.

description.ko: 6m 안에 최대 1개의 올가미를 설치합니다. 0.4초 후 무장해 6초 기다리며, 적 진입 시 반경 2.5m의 최대 5명에게 D60% 냉기 피해와 3초간 40% 둔화를 줍니다. 적중 당시 중독된 적은 0.75초 빙결됩니다.
description.en: Place one snare within 6m; arm after 0.4s and wait up to 6s. On entry, hit up to 5 enemies in 2.5m for D60% cold damage and a 40% slow for 3s. Enemies poisoned at impact are frozen for 0.75s.

concept: A compact pair of thorn-bound archer gloves with short frozen bone briars winding over green leather backplates, frosty silver clamp cuffs and small poison-green inlays. Briars and frost are tangible fitted materials; no clouds or detached vines.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LA42, Winterthorn Grasp, class Ranger, slot gloves or gauntlets.
Subject design: A compact pair of thorn-bound archer gloves with short frozen bone briars winding over green leather backplates, frosty silver clamp cuffs and small poison-green inlays. Briars and frost are tangible fitted materials; no clouds or detached vines.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: If Frost Snare actually hits an enemy rooted by Briar Trap, apply D90% secondary poison damage over 3s. Root or cold alone cannot retrigger it; 4s per target.
Direct skill context: A09 Briar Trap — Place a trap within 6m. It arms after 0.4s and waits up to 6s. On enemy entry, hit up to 5 enemies in 2.5m for D80% physical damage and a 1.2s root, then remove it. Limit 1.; A10 Frost Snare — Place one snare within 6m; arm after 0.4s and wait up to 6s. On entry, hit up to 5 enemies in 2.5m for D60% cold damage and a 40% slow for 3s. Enemies poisoned at impact are frozen for 0.75s.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: square native PNG with real transparent alpha; the built-in 1254 by 1254 output is accepted, and 1024 by 1024 is also accepted. Preserve native pixels and alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Aim to contain the entire subject, including all tips and chain, within the central 76% with generous transparent padding. No part may be clipped or missing. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
